Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Gayatri Qureshi. I am a 53-year-old taxi driver living in Kochi. Kiran Naidu gave me a cheque for INR 43,60,000/- to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. My case number is CC/2635/2020 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kochi. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 89303 02798 or email gayatri.qureshi80@example.com.
